name: uninitialized bindings retain own falsy recorder values
uninitialized bindings do not inherit recorder values
array holes defaults and rest retain their indices
excluded object binding remains local among captured siblings
source: var {keep, skip} = {keep: 2, skip: 3}; var result = keep + skip;

name: object shorthand defaults aliases and rest use declaration wrapper
setup: const calls = []; _rec.define = (name, kind, value) => { calls.push([name, kind]); return value; };

name: bare hoisted var shadows module binding before declaration
source: var x = 9; function read() { return x; var x; } var result = read();

name: literal initialized hoisted var shadows module binding
source: var x = 9; function read() { var result = x; var x = 2; return result; } var result = read();

name: arrow hoisted var shadows module binding
source: var x = 9; var read = () => { var result = x; var x = 2; return result; }; var result = read();

name: block lexical declaration shadows before initialization
source: var x = 9; function read() { { try { return x; } catch (error) { return error.name; } let x = 2; } } var result = read();

name: block local binding does not hide outer binding afterwards
source: var x = 9; function read() { { let x = 2; } return x; } var result = read();

name: function and catch parameters remain local
source: var x = 9; function read(x) { try { throw 3; } catch (error) { return x + error; } } var result = read(2);

name: destructuring assignment expression returns original RHS
source: var x; var source = {x: 3}; var result = ({x} = source);

name: nested assignment defaults array rest and object rest preserve RHS
source: var x, y, rest, tail; var source = {nest: [undefined, 2, 3], keep: 4, extra: 5}; var result = ({nest: [x = 7, ...tail], keep: y, ...rest} = source);

name: assignment wrappers change captured targets while exclusions remain local
source: var x, skip; var source = {a: 3, b: 4}; var result = ({a: x, b: skip} = source);
setup: const calls = []; _rec.define = (name, kind, value) => { if (kind === "assignment") { calls.push([name, value]); return value * 10; } return value; };
